description: This file contains the implementation of the NoteService class in the service layer, providing operations for managing notes including listing, retrieving by ID, creating, updating, and deleting notes with error handling.

classes.name: NoteService
classes.description: Service layer class managing note operations with validation and error handling.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a page of notes using the provided pageable for pagination and sorting.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Returns a note by id or throws 404 if not found.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and returns a new note from the provided request payload.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing note or throws 404 if not found.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a note by id or throws 404 if not found.
